entries.title: Note titles have no maximum length
entries.summary: validateCreateInput and validateUpdateInput in src/utils/validation.ts accept a title of any length as long as it is a non-empty string after trimming. There is no maximum title length check.

entries.title: Create validation trims the note title
entries.summary: validateCreateInput in src/utils/validation.ts returns the title with surrounding whitespace removed (title.trim()). Content is returned unchanged.
